description: Returns an innovation record rendered as markdown, including the problem, solution, technical details, and prior art. With include_illustrations it also lists the drawings in its Illustrations section and the drawings it suggests preparing.

include_illustrations.description: true to also return illustrations (numbered as Drawing N in the markdown) and illustrationSuggestions, for example to check what is there before uploading

name: get_innovation

illustrationSuggestions.description: Drawings the innovation suggests preparing, as given in illustrationSuggestions at registration

illustrations.description: The drawings in the innovation's Illustrations section; number matches Drawing N in the markdown

title: Read innovation in Lightbringer
